exchangeable_units.definition: One company on the single session this cross-section covers.

attestations.rows_are_exchangeable: One session only, so no row shares a session with another: each row is its own unit. Checked by probes/panel_power.py on 2026-11-12 over the 1,600 rows; the within-unit correlation is undefined rather than zero, because no unit holds a second row.
